Gauri Banerjee
Talent Acquisition Specialist | Kolkata
gauri.banerjee438@example.com | +91 9221910598

A proactive Talent Acquisition Specialist with a strong focus on building scalable hiring processes and improving candidate experience. Skilled at leveraging HRIS and structured recruitment methodologies to reduce time-to-fill and improve hiring manager satisfaction. Collaborative team member with experience partnering with engineering and product teams in Agile environments.

Experience
Saffron Bank — Jun 2024 - Aug 2026
Talent Acquisition Specialist | Remote/Onsite
- Led Recruitment initiatives for fintech product and engineering teams, decreasing average time-to-fill from 49 to 32 days by redesigning interview stages and scorecards; tracked all requisitions in the HRIS.
- Managed end-to-end Talent Acquisition for 60+ hires across backend, frontend and QA; implemented weekly dashboards in Confluence to align hiring priorities with hiring managers and Agile sprint cycles.
- Optimized candidate sourcing channels and referral program, boosting qualified pipeline by 85% and improving offer acceptance rate to 78%; maintained candidate records and offer workflows in the HRIS.
- Partnered with Engineering leadership to run hiring sprints, conducted role-based debriefs, and standardized interview rubrics on Confluence; introduced Linux-focused technical screening tasks to better assess candidate fit.

Paystack India — May 2022 - May 2024
Recruiter | Hybrid
- Owned full-cycle Recruitment for payments and compliance teams, closing 48 roles in two years and reducing average cost-per-hire by 22% through targeted sourcing and process standardization in the HRIS.
- Built and maintained candidate pipelines for senior backend and DevOps roles with Linux skill requirements; coordinated technical assessments and interviewer calibration sessions documented in Confluence.
- Collaborated with Talent Acquisition partners to run campus and lateral hiring drives, improving offer-to-join velocity by introducing structured interview guides and consistent feedback loops aligned to Agile hiring sprints.
- Implemented weekly hiring metrics and candidate funnel reports in the HRIS, enabling hiring managers to make data-driven decisions and improving hiring forecast accuracy.

Projects
- Internal Interviewer Enablement Program: Designed a 6-week training module documenting interviewer best practices and scoring rubrics in Confluence; resulted in 40% fewer re-interviews and higher hiring manager satisfaction.
- Linux Technical Screening Pilot: Created a Linux-based pre-screen test for DevOps and backend candidates, increasing technical interview pass rate predictability by 30%.

Skills
Recruitment, Talent Acquisition, HRIS
Confluence, Agile, Linux

Education
B.Tech, Electronics, NIT Trichy
